content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository microsoft_cheriot-ibex_pr81, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# [bug, dbg] Don't cache instruction whilst in debug mode lowrisc/ibex#1472
CHERIoT Ibex does not disable the instruction cache when in debug mode, leading to incorrect behaviour. This was previously discovered and fixed in upstream Ibex in 2021-2022.
See [lowRISC Ibex issue 1472](https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/issues/1472) for details on the problem and [lowRISC Ibex commit 7b1be33](https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/commit/7b1be3354d650bc5b23dff6f439459c353288e4f) for the fix implemented.

full_path1/file1.py

```

I focused on where debug mode and instruction caching intersect. In Ibex the top‐level core instantiates the fetch stage (which in turn drives the I$), so you need to (a) carry the debug‐mode signal into the fetch block, (b) gate off the I$ when in debug, and (c) ensure the debug controller exports debug‐mode properly. The four RTL files most likely affected are:

```text
ip/ibex/data/rtl/ibex_core.sv
ip/ibex/data/rtl/ibex_fetch_stage.sv
ip/ibex/data/rtl/icache.sv
ip/ibex/data/rtl/ibex_debug_module.sv
```

– ibex_core.sv: hook up debug_mode_i to downstream blocks  
– ibex_fetch_stage.sv: detect debug_mode and bypass or invalidate I$  
– icache.sv: disable caching when debug_mode is asserted  
– ibex_debug_module.sv: export the core’s debug state so fetch/I$ can see it
